  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Yield curve explorer}

---

Use this page to browse the published RSYC yield curves and their validation
results. Choose a response, scale, spatial level, and model, then click an
area on the map. You can zoom with the mouse wheel and drag to pan.

The map can be coloured by the curve asymptote (parameter b1) or by a
validation statistic (CCC, R², bias, or RMSE). Most curves could not be
validated because too few ground plots were available in their area; these
are marked as not validated in the map tooltip and area list.

For the selected area, the explorer shows:

- the national and regional curves (black lines; regional dashed) up to age
  150 and, if the curve was validated, the validation plot means and their
  95% confidence intervals (red) for each 20-year age class;
- optional curves for other models (species) available in the same area;
- the curve parameters;
- validation statistics for the selected curve, and a scatterplot of all
  validated curves for the selected model and level, with the selected area
  in red.

See [Model validation](validation.html) for the validation method. Maximum
yield in the curve table is searched up to age 300. Bias is the RSYC
prediction minus the plot mean.

The address bar records the current selection, so you can share a link to
any view.

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="../validation/explorer.css">
<div id="rsyc-curve-explorer" data-base="../validation/"></div>
```
